mapper.sql: ATT_ID, LOGIN_ID, USER_NAME, DEPT_NAME, WORK_DATE, IN_AT, OUT_AT, IN_IP, OUT_IP
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ATTENDANCE (ATT_ID, LOGIN_ID, USER_NAME, DEPT_NAME, WORK_DATE, IN_AT, IN_IP) VALUES (#{attId}, #{loginId}, #{userName}, #{deptName}, #{workDate, jdbcType=DATE}, #{inAt}, #{inIp})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ATTENDANCE WHERE LOGIN_ID = #{loginId} AND WORK_DATE = #{day, jdbcType=DATE}
mapper.update: UPDATE ATTENDANCE SET OUT_AT = NULL, OUT_IP = NULL WHERE ATT_ID = #{attId} AND OUT_AT IS NOT NULL
UPDATE ATTENDANCE SET OUT_AT = #{at}, OUT_IP = #{ip} WHERE ATT_ID = #{attId} AND OUT_AT IS NULL
